structure: Part 11, Review, declaration and notification submitted. Read in full: journeys.fit.spec.js (417 lines) and snagging.fit.spec.js (557 lines), and mined all 5 traces end to end: (T1) journeys--the-notification-hub-review-with-tasks-missing-lists-each-incomplete-section.zip, 55 actions; (T2) journeys--the-notification-hub-the-submitted-page-is-guarded-until-the-declaration-is-confirmed.zip, 19 actions; (T3) snagging--notification-submitted-s38-submit-screen-import-notification-submitted.zip, 143 actions; (T4) snagging--review-your-notification-s34-review-your-notification-answers-still-missing.zip, 55 actions; (T5) snagging--review-your-notification-s35-review-your-notification-error-handling-on-a-refused-submit.zip, 75 actions. Every trace walks the opening run (create-notification, origin, what are you importing, reason, commodity details), which other parts own. Pages claimed here, in journey order: /review-notification (incomplete state in T1, T4, T5 at actions 40, 48, 57, 66; complete state in T3 action 119; refused Continue in T1 action 50, T4 action 48, T5 action 49; first error link followed in T5 action 57; a second, no-JavaScript context in T5 action 66), /declaration (T2 action 14, reached by the guard; T3 action 127, reached by Continue from a complete review), /notification-submitted (T3 action 136, after the declaration is confirmed; T2 action 13, refused with a 302 to /declaration). The review page always appears after the hub's Review and submit; the declaration only once the review is complete; the submitted page only once the declaration is confirmed. The declaration's error state, the germinal variant of the review and submitted pages, and the submitted notification viewed by reference are not rendered in these 5 traces; they are claimed from journeys.fit.spec.js assertions (all 156 tests passed), with their refs on the spec line. Network: every call is a same-origin page request to the prototype kit (GET and POST to review-notification, declaration, notification-submitted); no outbound data call was seen.

I can legally act on behalf of a third party in relation to the conditions of this declaration.

    await expect(page.locator('main')).toContainText('Submitted')
